name: Location
definition: Where the reports place the property or its centre of work, as coordinates.

name: Map sheet
definition: The NTS or BCGS map sheet the reports give for the property.

name: Mining division
definition: The BC mining division the reports name for the property.

name: Access
definition: How the reports say the property is reached.

name: Commodities
definition: Metals the reports say are sought or present on the property.

name: Geological setting
definition: Rock units, ages and structures the reports describe on the property.

name: Mineralization
definition: Sulphide and metal-bearing minerals and zones the reports describe on the property.

name: Geophysical surveys
definition: Geophysical surveys done on the property, with type, year and size as stated.

name: 2022 drilling
definition: Diamond drilling done on the property in 2022: total metres drilled and the significant intervals reported.

name: 2023 drilling
definition: Diamond drilling done on the property in 2023: total metres drilled and the significant intervals reported.

name: Recommended next work
definition: Work the reports recommend doing next on the property, with any budget stated.

name: Resource estimate
definition: A mineral resource or reserve estimate stated for the property, with tonnage and grade.
